outcome: Response to antibiotic treatment (Clarithromycin and Tobramycin)
cohort: The study participants were forty-four patients in two private hospitals in Jhapa district of Nepal who presented with painful, draining subcutaneous nodules indicative of delayed post-operative surgical site infections.
finding: Non-tuberculous Mycobacteria, specifically Mycobacterium Chelone, were identified as causative agents in delayed surgical site infections following various operations, with most patients responding to treatment with Tobramycin and Clarithromycin.
